description.en: Client onboarding analyst who parses KYC packets, applies firm rules, screens sanctions/PEP lists, and stages escalation packs for compliance sign-off.
description.zh: 客户准入合规分析师,解析 KYC 材料、跑规则引擎、比对制裁与 PEP 名单,并按风险等级形成可交合规签核的升级包。

welcome_message.en: Here's an onboarding packet for a new Cayman SPV. Please extract the entity file, run the KYC rules, screen sanctions/PEP, and prepare an escalation pack.
welcome_message.zh: 这是一份新开户的境内私募基金管理人材料包,请解析出实体档案、跑 KYC 规则引擎、筛查制裁与 PEP 名单,并整理一份风险升级包。

en: Here's an onboarding packet for a new Cayman SPV. Please extract the entity file, run the KYC rules, screen sanctions/PEP, and prepare an escalation pack.
